claims.text: The source builds a CNN VQGAN codebook (|Z|=1024 typical; 256x256 to 16x16=256 indices) with perceptual + patch-discriminator losses, then models code sequences with a GPT-2-medium latent transformer (307M, sliding window for megapixel).

Reported numbers: same-representation NLL favours Transformer over PixelSNAIL on RIN/LSUN-CT/IN/D-RIN/S-FLCKR; CIFAR-10 +18.63% FID at 14.08x faster sampling vs pixels; COCO-Stuff FID 22.4, ADE20K 35.5.

limitations.text: Recorded locator 2012.09812 is a transcription defect (resolves to unrelated paper); claims above rest on verified-correct 2012.09841. Future Discovery repair should correct the locator.
